name: getReligion
description: This tool retrieves Religion master data from EIM/Religion.aspx in PeoplesHR. It can search religions by exact code or by partial religion name, return results using the same paging behavior as the UI (page size and page navigation), and optionally fetch all religions across all pages when the user explicitly requests “all records”. It also supports returning a specific page (e.g., “6th page”) and provides navigation hints (next/previous availability) to continue fetching more records safely.

basic.name: getReligion
basic.description: This tool retrieves Religion master data from EIM/Religion.aspx in PeoplesHR. It can search religions by exact code or by partial religion name, return results using the same paging behavior as the UI (page size and page navigation), and optionally fetch all religions across all pages when the user explicitly requests “all records”. It also supports returning a specific page (e.g., “6th page”) and provides navigation hints (next/previous availability) to continue fetching more records safely.

args.name: religionCode
args.description: user enters the religion code to search for and return the grid row details, including religion name

args.name: religionName
args.description: Religion name search text (partial allowed, example: "Christ"). Also accepts "all", "show all", "*" to fetch all records.

args.name: page
args.description: Page number to return (example: "6"). If omitted, defaults to "1". You may also pass "next" / "prev" with currentPage.

args.name: currentPage
args.description: Current page number (used only when page is "next" or "prev").

args.name: batchSize
args.description: How many records to return per response (example: "10"). If not given, it returns UI page size.

args.name: useUiPageSize
args.description: "true" (default) uses UI page size; "false" lets batchSize drive the size.

args.name: returnAll
args.description: "true" to fetch all pages and return all records.
